summary: AiMind compares Claude Fable 5.2 against Gemini 4 Carbon on generating a 3D animated simulation of an iceberg flipping and tossing a boat from a single prompt.
summaryEn: Flip an Iceberg: Claude Fable 5.2 vs Gemini 4 Carbon

post.originalText:
~30x cheaper. Claude Fable 5.2 vs Gemini 4 Carbon, same prompt: flip an iceberg.

Claude Fable 5.2 - ~$10
Gemini 4 Carbon - ~$0.30

One prompt each, no edits.

Can you tell which one costs $10?

sourceMaterials.text: @semichenkko Cheaper one looks just as good honestly
sourceMaterials.author: AIMind_Ai

sourceMaterials.text: @maixbt The gap is wild. Outputs are closer than the price suggests
sourceMaterials.author: AIMind_Ai

sourceMaterials.text: @gosh_sol_eth Top is Claude. The flip and boat toss still look way more alive. Gap’s real, even if not the full 30x.
sourceMaterials.author: AIMind_Ai

sourceMaterials.text: @_aiflood_ One shot still shows the gap clearly, though.
sourceMaterials.author: AIMind_Ai

sourceMaterials.text: @Klonzu Top has more depth, but 30x cheaper for nearly the same is the real flex
sourceMaterials.author: AIMind_Ai
